terms.metaDesc: The rules for using the TERANGA LABS service: briefs, Tokens and matching.
terms.title: Terms of use
terms.lead: By using TERANGA LABS, you accept the following rules.

s1.b: TERANGA LABS is a matching service between clients who post the need for a website for 1 Token and developers who unlock the contact with a Token.

s2.b:
Posting a brief costs 1 Token and is reserved for people able to take on the commitments described.

  • the information provided must be accurate;
  • the brief must relate to a real and serious project;
  • any abusive or fraudulent use is penalized by account deletion.

s3.b:
A Token unlocks a contact on a brief. Usual rate: 1 Token = 2,500 FCFA.

  • a Token is consumed when the contact is unlocked;
  • purchases are currently made through the team; online payment is coming soon;
  • transactions are final once the contact is unlocked, except in proven dispute.

s4.b: Direct contact with the client is the very purpose of the service: the developer who unlocks a brief with 1 Token obtains the contact and continues the exchange in the built-in messenger, then directly (WhatsApp) after mutual agreement. Developers and clients are responsible for their exchanges and for concluding their own contract. TERANGA LABS takes no part in financial transactions between the parties and charges no commission.

s5.b:
• no spam, harassment or off-topic solicitation;
  • no resale of unlocked contacts to third parties;
  • every report is reviewed by the team.

s6.b: The content of a brief belongs to its author (the client). Developers may use it solely to respond to that brief. The TERANGA LABS brand, texts and visual identity may not be reused without written permission.

s7.b:
A Token spent on a contact cannot be refunded. In case of a fraudulent contact or a fictitious brief, the report must be made within the 48 hours following the unlocking of the contact.

Reports are made from the conversation via the “Report” button. The team reviews the exchanges and refunds in Tokens if the dispute is confirmed.

s8.b: TERANGA LABS provides a matching service. The quality of the work delivered, adherence to deadlines and project content are the sole responsibility of the developer, and the accuracy of the brief that of the client. Our liability is limited to the amount of Tokens involved.

s9.b: TERANGA LABS evolves continuously: pricing, rules and features may change. The terms in force are those published on this page. Using the service after an update constitutes acceptance of the new rules.

s10.b: To report abuse, fraud or a breach of these terms, write to us at contact@terangalabs.sn or use the report button present on each piece of content.

s11.b: All legal notifications are addressed to contact@terangalabs.sn. Please keep valid access to your login email address.

s12.b: TERANGA LABS may suspend any account in case of non-compliance with these terms, and reserves the right to evolve the service and its pricing. In the event of a dispute, Senegalese law applies and the courts of Dakar have jurisdiction.

privacy.metaDesc: How TERANGA LABS collects, uses and protects your personal data.
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.lead: Your data, your privacy: here is how TERANGA LABS handles them.

s1.b:
When you use the service, we collect:

  • your brief data: name, region, project type, budget and description;
  • your WhatsApp number, used for direct contact;
  • navigation data strictly necessary for operation.

s2.h: Why do we collect this data?
s2.b:
This data is used solely to:

  • match clients and developers;
  • let you unlock a contact with a Token;
  • ensure moderation and prevent abuse.

We do not sell your data, and we never share it for advertising purposes.

s3.b: A brief's contact (WhatsApp number) is only visible to developers who unlock the contact with a Token. No other disclosure is made without your consent.

s4.b: Data is kept for as long as necessary to provide the service: your session stays active for 30 days (see the cookie policy), your briefs stay visible while they are open, and account data is deleted upon request. Security logs are kept for 12 months, then anonymized.

s5.b: Our infrastructure is hosted with a web provider such as Supabase (database, authentication, storage). These providers may not use your data for their own purposes and only access it to ensure the proper functioning of the service.

s6.b:
We apply technical and organizational measures suited to the sensitivity of the data:

  • passwords hashed, never stored in plaintext;
  • secure sessions with httpOnly cookies;
  • data access restricted by role (client or developer);
  • WhatsApp hidden by default, revealed only during a conversation.

s7.b: The service is reserved for people able to take on contractual commitments. A minor may not use TERANGA LABS without the consent of a legal representative.

s8.b: The cookies we use serve exclusively for authentication and technical operation. They are never used for advertising purposes.

s9.b: Under Senegalese law No. 2008-12 on the protection of personal data, you may request access to, rectification or deletion of your data by writing to contact@terangalabs.sn.

cookies.metaDesc: How TERANGA LABS uses cookies and trackers to run the service and keep you signed in.
cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.lead: We keep your session signed in with cookies, and nothing else.

groups.name: Essential authentication cookies
groups.description: Created by Supabase Auth, they keep your session active and secure (30 days). Deleted when you sign out. They are strictly necessary for the service: without them, signing in or accessing your space is impossible.

groups.name: Next.js technical cookies
groups.description: Used only for rendering pages and navigation. No personal data is stored in them.

groups.name: Local preferences (localStorage)
groups.description: Interface settings such as “reduce animations” are stored on your device. They never leave your browser.

groups.name: No advertising or tracking cookies
groups.description: TERANGA LABS does not use targeted advertising, does not pass any cookie to ad networks and does not resell any data.

s1.b: A cookie is a small file stored by your browser. At TERANGA LABS, cookies serve one single purpose: keeping you signed in securely for up to 30 days, as you requested.

s3.b:
By default, when you sign in, a session cookie with a duration of 30 days is set. You stay signed in between visits, so you do not have to type your password again.

You can end this session at any time using the “Sign out” button in the navigation bar: the cookie is then immediately deleted from your device.

s4.b: Essential authentication cookies do not require consent: they are indispensable to the service. Local preferences can be erased at any time from your browser settings. If you block all cookies, signing in to TERANGA LABS will be impossible.

s5.b: A question about this policy? Write to us at contact@terangalabs.sn.
